passages.translation: 恐惧可以成为改变行为的有效方式。一项研究比较了高恐惧和低恐惧诉求对牙科卫生相关态度和行为变化的影响。一组受试者观看可怕的蛀牙和患病牙龈图片；另一组则观看不太吓人的材料，如塑料牙齿、图表和图形。观看恐怖材料的受试者报告了更多焦虑，并且比低恐惧组有更强烈的愿望去改变他们护理牙齿的方式。但这些反应是否真正转化为更好的牙科卫生习惯？为了回答这个重要问题，受试者在实验后两次（五天和六周后）被召回实验室。他们咀嚼牙疾诊断片，这种药片会给牙齿上任何未清洁的区域染上红色，从而直接显示他们实际护理牙齿的程度。结果显示，高恐惧诉求确实带来了更显著、更持久的牙科卫生变化。也就是说，接触高恐惧警告的受试者比接触低恐惧警告的受试者刷牙更仔细。然而，要成为一种有效的说服手段，信息不能太吓人，并且必须给予人们具体的指导，以帮助他们减少恐惧的根源。如果不这样做，他们可能会通过否认信息或传播者的可信度来减少焦虑。如果发生这种情况，态度或行为改变就不太可能发生。

questions.analysis: 空格前后为 pictures of ___ teeth and diseased gums，需形容词修饰 teeth，且与 diseased gums 并列，表示“蛀坏的牙齿”，故选 decayed。
空格在 a greater ___ to change... 中，需名词，且后接不定式 to change，表示“改变的意愿”，故选 desire。
空格前为 were these reactions actually，后接 into，构成 be translated into 固定搭配，意为“转化为”，故选 translated。
空格在 on two ___ (five days and six weeks...)，需复数名词，on two occasions 表示“在两次场合/两次”，故选 occasions。
空格在 a direct ___ of how well... 中，需单数名词，indication 表示“指示、显示”，符合语义。
空格在 more ___ changes 中，需形容词修饰 changes，permanent 意为“持久的”，与 greater 并列表示“更显著更持久的变化”。
空格在 subjects ___ to high-fear warnings 中，需过去分词作后置定语，exposed to 意为“接触/暴露于”，符合句意。
空格在 brushed their teeth more ___ than 中，需副词修饰 brushed，carefully 意为“仔细地”，符合刷牙语境。
空格在 given ___ guidelines 中，需形容词修饰 guidelines，concrete 意为“具体的”，符合“提供具体指导”的搭配。
空格在 the ___ of the communicator 中，需名词，credibility 意为“可信度”，表示传播者的可信度。

passages.reference: It is often said that one should not put all eggs in one basket, and this advice holds true in many aspects of life. Concentrating all resources, time, or hopes on a single option may seem efficient, but it exposes us to enormous risks if that option fails. For instance, in financial investment, a person who invests all savings in one stock may lose everything when the market turns volatile. Similarly, a student who devotes all energy to only one job application or one scholarship may end up with nothing if rejected. By contrast, diversifying our choices, such as applying to several universities or keeping a backup plan, can effectively reduce potential losses and increase chances of success. In conclusion, putting all eggs in one basket is unwise because no one can predict the future perfectly. Unexpected changes, such as economic downturns or personal setbacks, can destroy a single plan. A wise person always prepares alternatives and spreads risks. Therefore, we should avoid over-reliance on a single path and learn to diversify our efforts.
passages.note: 范文紧扣“不要把所有鸡蛋放在一个篮子里”的寓意，先指出集中资源的风险，再用投资和求职/奖学金两个例子说明单一选择脆弱，最后对比分散选择的优势，论证充分。结构为“引出观点—举例论证—总结建议”，清晰完整。可复用句型包括It is often said that...; Concentrating...may seem..., but it exposes...; For instance... Similarly... By contrast...; In conclusion... Therefore...。语言平实，逻辑连接自然。

passages.reference: Chinese buzzwords usually reflect social changes and culture, and some are becoming increasingly popular in foreign media. For example, tuhao and dama are both old words, but they have taken on new meanings. Tuhao used to refer to rural landlords who oppressed their tenants and servants, but now it is used to refer to people who spend money like water or like to show off their wealth. That is to say, a tuhao has money but no taste. Dama is a term for middle-aged women, but now it specifically refers to Chinese women who bought large quantities of gold when the gold price dropped not long ago. Tuhao and dama may be included in the new edition of the Oxford English Dictionary. So far, about 120 Chinese words have been added to the Oxford English Dictionary and have become part of the English language.
passages.note: 难点在于“热词”“花钱如流水”“没有品位”等口语化表达的转换，以及“被收入”“被加进”的被动语态。译文保留“tuhao”“dama”拼音，用 buzzwords、spend money like water、taste 等单词，并对“大妈”作同位语解释，使语义清晰自然。
